'''Ukabi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He worked as a crime boss, and his refusal to ally himself with the Empire started a conflict that ultimately caused his [[Death/Legends|death]] and severely damaged his organization's business on the planet.

==Biography==
Ukabi led an [[Exchange]]-affiliated criminal organization in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa's]] [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Imperial Diplomatic Service|diplomat]] [[Maro Vizhen]] was sent to oversee the creation of the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]], which would unite four powerful crime bosses, including Ukabi, in an alliance with the Empire. Ukabi, however, refused to join the group.<ref name="Destruction">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|A Crushing Blow|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

As Ukabi's operations were now a nuisance and a threat to the Empire's interests, Maro Vizhen employed the services of an Imperial-aligned individual to disrupt his group's activities. Both his group's men and infrastructure were target of a massive attack,<ref name="Destruction" /> to which Ukabi retaliated with all-out war. The Empire's enforcer managed to invade Ukabi's base of operations and kill his four trusted lieutenants, only to find that Ukabi had Vizhen cornered in her own base. Before dealing with the diplomat, Ukabi was confronted and struck down by the enforcer.<ref name="Death">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|Tearing Apart the Foe|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Look upon my body. Cortosis skin grafts. Intravenous kolto injection system. Holographic targetting array. You are only mortal, I will always prevail.|Ukabi, to the Empire enforcer sent to eliminate him.|<ref name="Death" />}}
Ukabi was a powerful warrior. His body had numerous [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants designed to enhance his survival and fighting capabilities. He was also a competent and ruthless leader, forcing the Empire to recognize him as a threat.

==Behind the scenes==
Ukabi and his gang are the main antagonists of a series of missions in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', available to all Imperial classes.
